title: Git
subtitle: Repository bindings and code delivery across your projects
default_description: Used by tasks without a project and projects without a repository in compatibility mode.
project_description: Project repositories override workspace defaults. A platform connection is optional for code checkout.
empty_bindings: No project repositories. Attach a repository to get started.
empty_pr: No mirrored PR / MR matching this view. Connect a platform and configure its webhook; history is not imported automatically.
error: Could not load Git data. Check the server version and migration status, then retry.
no_connections: No platform connections configured. Repositories can still be used by a daemon with Git access.
default_copy: Copy default repository to a project
effective_default: No project repositories; tasks inherit the workspace defaults.
path_required: Enter the full platform repository path.
mode_warning: Project-only and no-Git modes require the updated daemon. Older daemons cannot launch runs with these modes. Existing runs keep their original configuration.
filter_by_task: Filter PR / MR by this task
live_changes_hint: Latest changes from the platform, not uncommitted local files.
unsupported_provider: In-app diffs are not available for this provider. View the original pull request.
changes_error: Unable to read changes. Check the server version, connection and read permissions, or view on the platform.
patch_truncated: Platform or display limits have truncated the diff. View the full change on the platform.
patch_unavailable: No text diff was provided (for example, a binary or oversized file).
no_matching_pr: No PR / MR matches the current filters.
